name: 置中的標誌＋橫向連結列，下方小標誌與一行小字
desc: 上方一列水平置中，標誌在左、橫向文字連結在右；隔一大段留白後，下方置中放較小的標誌和一行小字。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的頁尾，放在頁面最下方，跟著頁面捲動。所有元素水平置中，由上往下分成兩組，兩組之間留大片空白。上組是一列橫向排列的元素，整列橫跨頁面內容寬度（約畫面寬的三分之二），彼此垂直置中對齊：標誌在左端，為頁尾裡最大的元素；標誌右側緊接一列橫向依序排開的文字連結（沒有小標題）；最右端是另一個文字連結，與連結列之間以一條短直線分隔，靠右對齊到內容寬度的右緣。下組是底部列，置中：上方是一個明顯小於上組標誌的第二個標誌，下方是一行小字置中。
mobile: 改為全部水平置中、由上往下堆疊：標誌在最上方，仍是最大的元素；其下是文字連結列，仍橫向排成一列置中，排不下時自動換行；原本最右端的文字連結移到下一行置中，短直線分隔取消。留白後是底部列：第二個標誌置中，下方一行小字置中。頁尾下方的留白明顯小於上方，一行小字接近頁尾底緣。沒有動態效果。

en.name: Centered logo + horizontal link row, with a small logo and a line of small text below
en.desc: A centered top row with the logo on the left and horizontal text links on the right; after a large gap, a smaller logo and a line of small text are centered below.
en.prompt: Create a footer whose height is determined by its content, placed at the very end of the page and scrolling with it. All elements are horizontally centered and split into two groups from top to bottom, with a large empty space between the groups. The upper group is a single horizontal row spanning the page content width (about two-thirds of the viewport width), with its elements vertically centered against each other: the logo sits at the left end and is the largest element in the footer; immediately to the right of the logo is a row of text links laid out one after another (no group headings); at the right end is one more text link, separated from the link row by a short vertical divider and aligned to the right edge of the content width. The lower group is the bottom bar, centered: at the top is a second logo, clearly smaller than the logo in the upper group, and below it is a line of small text, centered.
en.mobile: Everything becomes horizontally centered and stacked top to bottom: the logo sits at the top and is still the largest element; below it, the row of text links stays a single centered horizontal row, wrapping when it does not fit; the text link that was at the right end moves to the next line, centered, and the short vertical divider is removed. After a gap comes the bottom bar: the second logo centered, with a line of small text centered below it. The spacing below the footer content is clearly smaller than the spacing above it, so the line of small text sits close to the bottom edge of the footer. There is no motion.
